what_this_is: The canonical, no-generation validation transcript of the R001 execution path on the formal node. It records what was checked, on which bytes, before any outcome exists. It is not a result and not a rollout log: no formal theorem was generated, no formal candidate was sent to the verifier, and no raw result file was created. Unlike the three frozen design artifacts, this file is a transcript of a machine event and therefore deliberately carries the host, the commit and the timestamp it was taken at; every hash in it is recomputable from the committed artifacts by the commands in `how_to_reproduce`.

validated_commit.subject: v3: implement R001 runner/analyzer and freeze execution amendments
validated_commit.role: the commit under validation; the dry run refuses a dirty tree, so this is exactly the code that was exercised

dry_run.verifier_events_note: the single verified event is the canary; no formal theorem was ever sent
dry_run.formal_result_files_search: find runs -name '*v3_r001*' -> only the pre-existing D001 tree; runs/v3_r001/rollout does not exist

host.hostname_note: the formal node's hostname is `ubuntu`; the frozen guard keys on the IP, which is the check the frozen code performs
host.host_guard_mode: On the formal path the host guard is enforced (`check_environment(require_formal_host=True)`): formal IP present, GPU is the frozen RTX 3080, no other compute job on the GPU, branch is `v3-jev-rl-controller`, the preregistration commit is an ancestor and the worktree is clean. In --dry-run the three host-only checks are report-only by design and the remaining three are still enforced; the values above are the ones the guard reads, recorded here so the report-only mode leaves evidence rather than silence.

sample_structure.plan_order: rank_by_q_B2 ascending, never re-sorted by the runner

what_is_checked: the frozen rendering (`prompt_of`, the function the q scores were computed on) re-tokenizes to exactly the frozen `prompt_token_count`
the canonical generation prompt (E023/E024 `build_prompt_text`) equals that rendering once chat-template special tokens are skipped
the `# Formal Statement:` block equals the pinned parquet statement under `_normalize`, at the frozen `formal_char_count`
prompt_identity_checks.enforcement: fail-closed: any mismatch raises FrozenViolation and the run stops before a model is loaded; all 128 passed

seed_scheme.formal_sample_rank: 1..128 in the frozen draw order (the order `membership_hashes.statement_ids_sha256` is taken in); amendment B, chosen because it is independent of q_B2, q_B1, source and of every future outcome
seed_scheme.seed_set_sha256_note: serialization is (formal_sample_rank, sample_index, seed) in plan order (rank_by_q_B2 ascending), the same object `seed_set_sha256(plan)` hashes in the runner. Recomputing it from the frozen manifest reproduces this exact value, so the runner's schedule and the manifest's schedule are the same schedule; the draw-order serialization is a different serialization of the same 1024 seeds.

verifier.policy: B0 reliability policy (`VerificationSession`), sequential and conservative rather than E024's 4-worker path -- an infrastructure execution choice, not a treatment difference (owner amendment C)

canary.note: the canary is `tinylean_v2_canary`; the runner checks no formal prompt contains it, and the canary was verified before any generation was contemplated

verifier.fail_close: an unhealthy verifier aborts before generation; a mid-run unhealthiness keeps whole groups and resumes, and unresolved infrastructure outcomes stay censored/missing rather than becoming labels

tests_on_fly122_at_this_commit.count_reconciliation: The 421 / 423 pair the owner flagged as inconsistent were both mid-implementation readings of a growing suite; the authoritative numbers are the ones above, measured on the formal node at the commit under validation. The 7 pre-outcome amendment tests are what moved 423 to 430.
